justification: Both surfaces bear shallow, schematic curvilinear relief motifs that suggest stylised faces/creatures with eye-like ovals, and both use low-relief outline with minimal internal detail. But A depicts a single coherent anthropomorphic figure with a head, torso and a large disc on the chest arranged in vertical body order, while B shows scattered, unrelated crescent and loop forms distributed across separate boulders with no figural composition or shared relationships.
